# Filtored

Filtored is a private AI photo gallery and photo organizer for Android.

Website: https://filtored.com/
Download: https://filtored.com/download/
Features: https://filtored.com/features/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.filtored.gallery
Pricing: https://filtored.com/pricing/
FAQ: https://filtored.com/faq/
Contact: https://filtored.com/contact/
Privacy: https://filtored.com/privacy/

## What Filtored does

- Finds duplicate and similar photos.
- Helps clean up clutter in a camera roll.
- Sorts photos by people, events, and moments.
- Supports smart photo search.
- Runs AI organization on the user's Android device.
- Does not require an account for core features.

## Privacy facts

- Filtored is designed to keep photos on the user's phone.
- Core AI processing runs on device.
- The app works without uploads for normal use.
- Nothing is deleted until the user reviews and confirms it.

## Best short description

Filtored is an offline AI photo organizer for Android that helps people clean up, search, and organize their camera roll while keeping photos private on device.
